implementation: Visible query/field drafts are separate from accepted rows; one owned cancellable one-second delay publishes only the current draft.
Sorted/filtered rows are cached by accepted catalog and presentation; native signatures, selected-index mapping and namespace arrays avoid whole-catalog work on draft repaints.

Accepted filter has explicit publication revision; exact-byte Unicode/reference metadata, current branch, date-format/locale/time-zone changes invalidate the appropriate projection. Relative dates update visible cells on a retired-on-close timer.

Clear/cancel/Escape, refresh and namespace navigation apply immediately; sorting reorders accepted rows while preserving a pending draft. Children/rename/busy/Quit pause publication; live editable owners resume their current draft.
Captured menus bind displayed accepted rows; draft and accepted-projection changes retire stale receipts. OK remains usable for the currently displayed selection while a filter waits.

Quit cancels/pauses owned delays, returns Later until actual completion, then continues existing document policy once; declined Quit resumes only live browser drafts. Three existing termination reply sites share settlement without changing the injected reply callback.
Existing Commit group Check/Uncheck commands now use the established Add/Revert glyphs and context-icon preference; existing captured actions and staging behavior unchanged.
